description: Return competitor positioning entries (QuickBooks, Xero, FreshBooks, Wave, Zoho Books, Tally) with where HelloBooks wins, where the competitor wins, and pricing notes. Optional country, tier (primary / secondary), and id filters.

country.description: Only return competitors whose primary market is this country, or who are also evaluated in this market.

id.description: Return a single competitor by id (e.g. "quickbooks", "xero", "tally").

tier.description: Filter to head-on rivals (primary) or adjacent / segment-specific overlaps (secondary).

name: list_competitors
